rows.getting_there:
Buses 12 and 40 stop outside on Foundry Lane.
Canal Street station is a 6-minute walk.
Bike racks in the yard. No parking at the venue.
rows.accessibility:
Level access through the main doors. A lift goes to the balcony. Accessible toilets on both floors.
Companion tickets are no charge. Tell us at checkout or email hello@waveform.example.
rows.policies:
Bags and re-entry follow each show, shown on its page.
Cloakroom by the main doors, $2.00 per item.
rows.faq:
Can I buy on the door?
Usually, if there are tickets left. Pay-at-the-door tickets are card or cash.

Is there a cloakroom?
Yes, by the main doors. $2.00 per item, card or cash.

rows.subject: Hollow Tide has moved to Fri 11 Sep
rows.body:
Hi there,

Hollow Tide has moved from Sat 15 Aug to Fri 11 Sep. Your tickets are valid for the new date — you don't need to do anything.

If you can't make it, ask for a refund until Fri 4 Sep from My tickets, or reply to this email.

Sorry for the change,
Waveform
